# PodcastBrief

> Structured, cited briefs from podcast episodes. Submit an Apple Podcasts episode URL; get back a brief with summary, ideas, insights, quotes, habits, claims, validated reference links, and recommendations. Asynchronous: typical turnaround 2–5 minutes.

## For agents

- OpenAPI: https://www.podcastbrief.app/openapi.json
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <pb_live_...>` (a human creates keys at POST /api/v1/keys while signed in; keys are environment-scoped and revocable)
- Pricing: 1 credit per hour of audio, rounded up. Credits are prepaid by a human at https://www.podcastbrief.app/billing.
- Flow: POST /api/v1/briefs once → receive 202 with `Location` and `Retry-After` → poll GET /api/v1/briefs/{id} until `status=complete`. Do not re-POST while a brief is in flight.
- 409 `brief_already_queued`: an episode with the same URL is already queued or generating for this account. Do not POST again — keep polling the returned `status_url`.
- 409 `brief_already_exists`: a completed brief for this episode already exists; the response carries its `brief_id`.
- 402 `insufficient_credits`: the account is out of credits. The human owner must top up manually at the returned `top_up_url`; there is no automatic purchase. Stop retrying and tell the human.
- 429: slow down; respect `Retry-After`.
- Brief lifecycle: `queued` → `generating` → `complete`. A complete brief carries `output_markdown`; failures are reported through the brief's status without internal error details.
- Inputs accepted today: Apple Podcasts episode links containing `?i=`. Episodes up to 4 hours.
- No CAPTCHA or browser challenge is required on `/api/v1` — your API key and prepaid credits are the credential. Abuse is controlled by per-key rate limits.

## Humans

- App: https://www.podcastbrief.app/
